entities.name: Query DapB enzyme
observations: 265 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 26.66 kDa and theoretical pI 5.35.
Contains Pfam DapB_N (PF01113) and DapB_C (PF05173) domains spanning nearly the full sequence.
Has 98.5–100% query coverage and approximately 51% identity to reviewed DapB homologs A8LL24, Q21CH6, and Q5LLT7.
Best-supported function is 4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate reductase (DapB), EC 1.17.1.8, in the cytosolic lysine biosynthesis pathway.

entities.name: DapB
observations: Catalyzes reduction of (S)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinate to (2S,4S)-4-hydroxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinate in the diaminopimelate pathway.
Uses NAD+ or NADP+ as the oxidized nicotinamide cofactor in the reaction representation; the physiological cofactor preference is not resolved by this sequence analysis.
The reverse-form Rhea equations are RHEA:35323 for NAD+/NADH and RHEA:35331 for NADP+/NADPH.

entities.name: DapB reduction reaction
observations: Rhea-mapped reaction: (S)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinate + NAD(+) + H2O = (2S,4S)-4-hydroxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinate + NADH + H(+), RHEA:35323.
An NADP-linked equivalent is also annotated: substrate + NADP(+) + H2O = hydroxytetrahydrodipicolinate + NADPH + H(+), RHEA:35331.
In the biosynthetic direction, this is commonly described as reduction of 4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate to tetrahydrodipicolinate using NAD(P)H.
